subject: 1 Cabot Road Medical Office Special Permit
overview: The board recommended approval of a special permit and site plan review for Cambridge Health Alliance to relocate its outpatient services to 1 Cabot Road. The recommendation included specific conditions for bicycle parking, pedestrian wayfinding, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

items.title: 1 Cabot Road Special Permit and Site Plan Review
items.summary: Recommended that the City Council approve a special permit and site plan review for Cambridge Health Alliance to relocate its outpatient medical services to a 56,000-square-foot space. The recommendation includes conditions that the applicant install visitor bicycle racks near entrances, provide pedestrian wayfinding from Wellington Station, and evaluate the feasibility of additional electric vehicle charging stations.

items.title: Approval of Minutes

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on the city's zoning overhaul project, requesting board feedback on the site plan review process and announcing upcoming public charrettes for the Broadway Corridor study.
